core_obligations: Local criterion: for every prime the localization of the dualizing complex is again dualizing, and by uniqueness of dualizing complexes the local Gorenstein condition is equivalent to invertibility of that localization (proof lines 4021-4026)

Openness: if one local ring is Gorenstein then the localized complex has a single nonzero cohomology module isomorphic to the local ring, and finiteness plus faithfulness of dualizing complexes spread this over a principal open neighbourhood, which makes the Gorenstein locus open (proof lines 4028-4043)

Global criterion: the two implications of the first item follow from the local statement and the openness argument, and the second part reduces to locality of dualizing complexes once the complex is known to be locally a shift of the ring (proof lines 4045-4059)
proof_roadmap: 对每个素因子 p，(ω_A^•)_p 是对偶复形（dualizing-localize），再由对偶复形唯一性 (dualizing-unique) 得 (1)(b)。
(1)(c)：A_p Gorenstein ⇒ (ω_A^•)_p 只有一个非零上同调模 ≅ A_p；由有界有限性取 f ∉ p 使 (ω_A^•)_f 只有一个非零上同调且由一个元素生成；由对偶复形的忠实性得 A_f ≅ H^{n_x}((ω_A^•)_f) ⇒ D(f) 上每点 Gorenstein ⇒ 集合开。
(1)(a) 由 (1)(b) 与上一段的局部化论证；(2) 由 (1) 知 ω_A^• 局部同构于 A 的移位，再由 dualizing-glue 的局部性得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the equivalences between the Gorenstein property of a Noetherian ring and the invertibility of a dualizing complex, both globally and after localizing, together with the openness of the Gorenstein locus, and identifies the case where the ring itself is a dualizing complex (author lemma at source lines 3997-4014, label lemma-gorenstein). The proof (source lines 4016-4060) localizes the complex, uses uniqueness of dualizing complexes for the local criterion, spreads invertibility from a point to a principal open neighbourhood by finiteness and faithfulness of the complex to get openness, and finishes the second part by locality of dualizing complexes (proof lines 4028-4059). The openness argument is the substance. H3.
